fields.position: Trains centroids with mini-batch EMAs of counts and sums. Every five batches it splits active donors to revive weak clusters, then finishes by averaging points under recorded final-epoch assignments.
fields.tradeoff: It changes clustering optimization, not GINGER's candidate read bandwidth or PiPNN II's construction-time scoring. CPU fixed-label MSE does not establish IVF recall or GPU throughput.

fields.summary: Added e-means to distinguish centroid training, graph construction, and query read bandwidth. Closing means can reduce the training objective under fixed assignments without guaranteeing lower held-out error or better retrieval performance.
